Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1259
Claimant:
Denise Turner
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
2 Nov 2023
The insured driver reported a low-speed head-on collision, and the policy shows the driver as a named insured on the
account. The claimant is represented by counsel, so all furtehr contact will go through the attorney's office.
20 Nov 2023
The police report and people at the scene place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. No independent
eyewitness saw the collision itself, so the account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
26 Jan 2024
Photgoraphs taken at the scene show damage that matches the described impact, and the repair estimate lines up
with those images. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior claims search.
23 Feb 2024
The claimant has given the same account of events in every conversation so far, including the first recorded
statement and later calls with the attorney. A wrist fracture was reported, and the injury fits the kind and force
expected from a crash of this type.
24 Feb 2024
A neighbor told our field contact that the car looked damaged some weeks before the claimed loss date. This has not
been confirmed by any other source, and I have asked for the neighbor's account in writing to see what they actually
observed.
9 Mar 2024
Treatment followed a usual course for this type of fracture and tapered off as the claimant improved. No prior injury to
the same body area is known from the medical records requested so far, and the file remains open pending the final
treatment summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
